configuration.title: Configuration
configuration.description: Configure your UniFi Network controller connection

entity.label: Name
entity.help: Unique name for this controller account.

validators.errorMsg: Name must begin with a letter and consist exclusively of alphanumeric characters and underscores.
Length of name should be between 1 and 50 characters.

entity.label: Controller URL
entity.help: UniFi controller address, e.g. 192.168.1.1 or https://192.168.1.1. HTTPS is added automatically if omitted.

validators.errorMsg: Controller URL is required.

entity.label: API Key
entity.help: UniFi Integration API key (X-API-KEY header). Generate in UniFi Network controller under Settings → Control Plane → Integrations.

validators.errorMsg: API Key is required.

entity.label: Verify SSL Certificate
entity.help: Enable to verify the controller TLS certificate. Disable for self-signed certificates (typical for on-premises controllers).

validators.errorMsg: Log level must be one of: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Manage UniFi data collection inputs. Sites are always collected. Enable additional data types below.

entity.label: Name
entity.help: Unique name for this input.

validators.errorMsg: Input name must begin with a letter and consist exclusively of alphanumeric characters and underscores.
Length of input name should be between 1 and 100 characters.

entity.label: Account
entity.help: Select the controller account to poll.

entity.label: Polling Interval (s)

validators.errorMsg: Polling Interval (s) must be either a non-negative number, CRON interval or -1.

entity.help: How often to collect data from the controller, in seconds.

validators.errorMsg: Index names must begin with a letter or a number and must contain only letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens.
Length of index name should be between 1 and 80.

entity.label: Collect Devices
entity.help: Collect device inventory for each site. Sites are always collected.

entity.label: Collect Clients
entity.help: Collect connected client list for each site.

entity.label: Collect Networks
entity.help: Collect network configurations for each site.

entity.label: API Page Size
entity.help: Number of objects per API page (1–200). Default: 200.

validators.errorMsg: Page size must be an integer between 1 and 200.

entity.label: HTTP Timeout (s)
entity.help: Timeout for each API request in seconds. Default: 120.

validators.errorMsg: Timeout must be an integer between 10 and 3600 seconds.

entity.label: Site Filter (optional)
entity.help: Comma-separated site UUIDs to collect. Leave empty to collect all sites.

services.name: unifi_inventory
services.title: UniFi Inventory
services.description: Polls UniFi configuration/inventory lists on one shared interval (default 180s). Toggle individual lists below; each shows its sourcetype.

entity.label: Name
entity.help: Unique name for this input.

validators.errorMsg: Input name must begin with a letter and consist exclusively of alphanumeric characters and underscores.
Length of input name should be between 1 and 100 characters.

entity.label: Account
entity.help: Select the controller account to poll.

entity.label: Polling Interval (s)

validators.errorMsg: Polling Interval (s) must be either a non-negative number, CRON interval or -1.

entity.help: How often to poll configuration/inventory lists, in seconds. Default 180. All inventory lists in this input share this interval.

entity.label: Index
entity.help: Send all UniFi data to the same index (recommended).

validators.errorMsg: Index names must begin with a letter or a number and must contain only letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens.
Length of index name should be between 1 and 80.

entity.label: Collect Devices (unifi:device)
entity.help: Adopted devices per site. Sourcetype: unifi:device. Docs: https://developer.ui.com/network/v10.4.57/getadopteddeviceoverviewpage

entity.label: Collect Clients (unifi:client)
entity.help: Connected clients per site. Sourcetype: unifi:client. Docs: https://developer.ui.com/network/v10.4.57/getconnectedclientoverviewpage

entity.label: Collect Networks (unifi:network)
entity.help: Networks per site. Sourcetype: unifi:network. Docs: https://developer.ui.com/network/v10.4.57/getnetworksoverviewpage

entity.label: Collect Device Tags (unifi:device_tag)
entity.help: Device tags per site. Sourcetype: unifi:device_tag. Docs: https://developer.ui.com/network/v10.4.57/getdevicetagpage

entity.label: Collect Firewall (unifi:firewall:zone, unifi:firewall:policy, unifi:acl_rule)
entity.help: Firewall zones, policies and ACL rules. Sourcetypes: unifi:firewall:zone, unifi:firewall:policy, unifi:acl_rule. Docs: https://developer.ui.com/network/v10.4.57/getfirewallpolicies

entity.label: Collect WiFi Broadcasts (unifi:wifi:broadcast)
entity.help: WiFi broadcasts (SSIDs). Sourcetype: unifi:wifi:broadcast. Docs: https://developer.ui.com/network/v10.4.57/getwifibroadcastpage

entity.label: Collect WAN Interfaces (unifi:wan)
entity.help: WAN interfaces per site. Sourcetype: unifi:wan. Docs: https://developer.ui.com/network/v10.4.57/getwansoverviewpage

entity.label: Collect Pending Devices (unifi:device:pending)
entity.help: Devices awaiting adoption (controller-wide). Sourcetype: unifi:device:pending. Docs: https://developer.ui.com/network/v10.4.57/getpendingdevicepage

entity.label: Collect Controller Info (unifi:info)
entity.help: Controller application version (controller-wide). Sourcetype: unifi:info. Docs: https://developer.ui.com/network/v10.4.57/getinfo

entity.label: Collect VPN (unifi:vpn:server, unifi:vpn:tunnel)
entity.help: VPN servers and site-to-site tunnels. Sourcetypes: unifi:vpn:server, unifi:vpn:tunnel. Docs: https://developer.ui.com/network/v10.4.57/getvpnserverpage

entity.label: Collect Switching (unifi:switching:lag, unifi:switching:mc_lag_domain, unifi:switching:switch_stack)
entity.help: LAGs, MC-LAG domains and switch stacks. Sourcetypes: unifi:switching:lag, unifi:switching:mc_lag_domain, unifi:switching:switch_stack. Docs: https://developer.ui.com/network/v10.4.57/getlagpage

entity.label: Collect DNS Policies (unifi:dns:policy)
entity.help: DNS policies per site. Sourcetype: unifi:dns:policy. Docs: https://developer.ui.com/network/v10.4.57/getdnspolicypage

entity.label: Collect Traffic Matching Lists (unifi:traffic_matching_list)
entity.help: Traffic matching lists per site. Sourcetype: unifi:traffic_matching_list. Docs: https://developer.ui.com/network/v10.4.57/gettrafficmatchinglists

entity.label: Collect RADIUS Profiles (unifi:radius:profile)
entity.help: RADIUS profiles per site. Sourcetype: unifi:radius:profile. Docs: https://developer.ui.com/network/v10.4.57/getradiusprofileoverviewpage

entity.label: Collect Hotspot Vouchers (unifi:hotspot:voucher)
entity.help: Hotspot vouchers per site. Sourcetype: unifi:hotspot:voucher. Docs: https://developer.ui.com/network/v10.4.57/getvouchers

entity.label: Collect Network Detail (unifi:network:detail, unifi:network:reference)
entity.help: Full per-network detail (IPv4/DHCP config, isolation, internet access) and references. 1-2 extra API calls per network. Sourcetypes: unifi:network:detail, unifi:network:reference. Docs: https://developer.ui.com/network/v10.4.57/getnetworkdetails

entity.label: API Page Size
entity.help: Number of objects per API page (1–200). Default: 200.

validators.errorMsg: Page size must be an integer between 1 and 200.

entity.label: HTTP Timeout (s)
entity.help: Timeout for each API request in seconds. Default: 120.

validators.errorMsg: Timeout must be an integer between 10 and 3600.

entity.label: Site Filter (optional)
entity.help: Comma-separated site UUIDs. Leave empty to auto-discover and collect all sites.

services.name: unifi_telemetry
services.title: UniFi Telemetry
services.description: Polls per-device performance statistics and detail on one shared interval (default 60s). One API call per device per enabled collector — raise the interval on large fleets.

entity.label: Name
entity.help: Unique name for this input.

validators.errorMsg: Input name must begin with a letter and consist exclusively of alphanumeric characters and underscores.
Length of input name should be between 1 and 100 characters.

entity.label: Account
entity.help: Select the controller account to poll.

entity.label: Polling Interval (s)

validators.errorMsg: Polling Interval (s) must be either a non-negative number, CRON interval or -1.

entity.help: How often to poll per-device telemetry, in seconds. One API call per device per enabled collector. Default 60. Raise this on large fleets to reduce request rate.

entity.label: Index
entity.help: Send all UniFi data to the same index (recommended).

validators.errorMsg: Index names must begin with a letter or a number and must contain only letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens.
Length of index name should be between 1 and 80.

entity.label: Collect Device Statistics (unifi:device:stats)
entity.help: Per-device CPU, memory, load average, uptime and uplink rates. One API call per device. Sourcetype: unifi:device:stats. Docs: https://developer.ui.com/network/v10.4.57/getadopteddevicelateststatistics

entity.label: Collect Device Detail (unifi:device:detail)
entity.help: Full per-device record: ports (PoE/speed/state), radios, uplink, provisionedAt. One API call per device. Sourcetype: unifi:device:detail. Docs: https://developer.ui.com/network/v10.4.57/getadopteddevicedetails

entity.label: API Page Size
entity.help: Number of objects per API page (1–200). Default: 200.

validators.errorMsg: Page size must be an integer between 1 and 200.

entity.label: HTTP Timeout (s)
entity.help: Timeout for each API request in seconds. Default: 120.

validators.errorMsg: Timeout must be an integer between 10 and 3600.

entity.label: Site Filter (optional)
entity.help: Comma-separated site UUIDs. Leave empty to auto-discover and collect all sites.

services.name: unifi_reference
services.title: UniFi Reference
services.description: Polls large near-static reference data (countries, DPI applications/categories) on one shared interval (default 86400s = daily).

entity.label: Name
entity.help: Unique name for this input.

validators.errorMsg: Input name must begin with a letter and consist exclusively of alphanumeric characters and underscores.
Length of input name should be between 1 and 100 characters.

entity.label: Account
entity.help: Select the controller account to poll.

entity.label: Polling Interval (s)

validators.errorMsg: Polling Interval (s) must be either a non-negative number, CRON interval or -1.

entity.help: How often to refresh static reference data, in seconds. Default 86400 (daily). These lists rarely change.

entity.label: Index
entity.help: Send all UniFi data to the same index (recommended).

validators.errorMsg: Index names must begin with a letter or a number and must contain only letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens.
Length of index name should be between 1 and 80.

entity.label: Collect Countries (unifi:ref:country)
entity.help: Country code reference list (~248 rows). Sourcetype: unifi:ref:country. Docs: https://developer.ui.com/network/v10.4.57/getcountries

entity.label: Collect DPI Applications (unifi:ref:dpi_application)
entity.help: Deep Packet Inspection application reference list (~2100 rows). Sourcetype: unifi:ref:dpi_application. Docs: https://developer.ui.com/network/v10.4.57/getdpiapplications

entity.label: Collect DPI Categories (unifi:ref:dpi_category)
entity.help: DPI application category reference list (~35 rows). Sourcetype: unifi:ref:dpi_category. Docs: https://developer.ui.com/network/v10.4.57/getdpiapplicationcategories

entity.label: API Page Size
entity.help: Number of objects per API page (1–200). Default: 200.

validators.errorMsg: Page size must be an integer between 1 and 200.

entity.label: HTTP Timeout (s)
entity.help: Timeout for each API request in seconds. Default: 120.

validators.errorMsg: Timeout must be an integer between 10 and 3600.
